app.pageCommands.appTooOld: Calling Ergo from a web page needs the latest Ergo app. Update the app and try again
app.pageCommands.voiceOff: The voice plugin isn't enabled: tap the button to type
app.pageCommands.notConnected: Ergo isn't connected yet. Try again in a moment
app.pageCommands.recorderNotReady: The recorder wasn't ready. Press and hold to try again
app.pageCommands.silent: Didn't hear anything. Press and hold to say it again
app.pageBubble.chooser.images: This page wants images (you can pick several)
app.pageBubble.chooser.files: This page wants files (you can pick several)
app.pageBubble.busy.queued: {name} is busy. You're next once this turn is done
app.pageBubble.placeholder.files: e.g. Attach the photos I took in Hangzhou last weekend
app.pageBubble.placeholder.text: e.g. Make the title “A weekend in Hangzhou”
app.daemonHttp.httpFailed: The daemon didn't answer (HTTP {status}); it may have just restarted — try again in a moment
app.daemonHttp.notJson: The daemon sent something that isn't data (it may have just restarted) — try again in a moment
app.daemonHttp.fileGone: Couldn't get the file (has the link expired?)
app.debugPage.safeAreaApp: App reports a bottom inset of {inset}; the page leaves {page} at the bottom
app.debugPage.noAccent: This style has no accent colors
app.debugPage.resetPage: Cleared this page's "microphone was denied" flag. The browser keeps its own notification permission, which the page can't clear (change it in the browser's site settings)
app.debugPage.appTooOld: The app is too old to reset this (needs an app from ticket 124 or later)
app.fileSource.notTextDetail: Its contents can't be shown here. Tap Download to open it with an app on this device.
app.fileSource.goneDetail: The server returned {status}: it may have been deleted, or the link is wrong.
app.fileSource.forbidden: No permission to view this file
app.fileSource.httpDetail: The server returned {status}. Tap refresh to try again later.
app.fileSource.unreachable: Couldn't connect ({error}). Check your connection, then tap refresh to try again.
app.fileSource.cutOff: The download was cut off ({error}). Tap refresh to try again later.
app.fileSource.appNoContent: The app didn't return the file's contents. Tap refresh to try again.
app.fileSource.appCantRead: The app couldn't read the file
app.fileSource.appBadContent: The app returned something unexpected. Tap refresh to try again.
app.nativeBrowser.bridgeGone: The page bridge on the web page is gone
app.nativeBrowser.refTooOld: The Ergo app on this device is too old. Install the latest version to upload by number
app.nativeVoice.noPrepareReply: the app didn't say whether the recorder is ready
app.nativeVoice.badPrepareReply: the app's recorder-ready reply was malformed
app.nativeVoice.noStartReply: the app didn't confirm the recording started
app.nativeVoice.badStartReply: the app's recording-started reply was malformed
app.nativeVoice.noRecording: the app didn't hand over the recording
app.nativeVoice.badRecording: the recording from the app was malformed
app.nativeVoice.notBase64: the recording from the app isn't base64
app.pagePick.expired: These suggestions expired. Ask Ergo to look again
app.pagePick.pageChanged: The page changed, so these suggestions no longer apply
app.pagePick.hintMultiple: Tap the ones to upload; you can pick several
app.pagePick.onlyOne: This upload box takes one file: pick one
app.pagePick.tooBig: Too large in total: pick fewer
app.pagePick.failedLocal: Upload failed: {reason} (you can tap Upload again)
app.voiceBrowser.insecure: The microphone can't be used from this address. Open Ergo over HTTPS (on a phone) or at http://127.0.0.1 on this computer
app.voiceNative.denied: No microphone permission. Turn on the microphone in the phone's Settings › Apps & services › Ergo › Permissions, then come back and hold to talk
app.voiceNative.released: Recording stopped because the app went to the background. This clip wasn't sent
app.voiceNative.interrupted: The system interrupted the recording (a call, or another app needed the microphone). This clip wasn't sent
app.voiceNative.error: Recording failed. This clip wasn't sent
app.voiceNative.errorWithMessage: Recording failed. This clip wasn't sent: {message}
app.voiceNative.releasedBeforeReady: The recorder was released before it was ready
app.voiceNative.appReleasedBeforeReady: The app released the recorder before it was ready. Press again to retry
app.voiceRecorder.denied: No microphone permission. Open the site settings at the left of the address bar, allow the microphone, then come back and hold to talk
app.voiceRecorder.micBusy: Another program is using the microphone, so recording isn't possible
app.voiceRecorder.closedBeforeOpen: The microphone was closed before it opened
app.voiceSession.silent: Nothing was recorded. Press again to retry
app.ws.manualReconnect: Disconnect & reconnect was tapped in Debug tools
app.ws.timeout: The daemon didn't reply within {seconds} seconds
app.ws.daemonTooOld: The daemon is too old for this request ({message})
